theorem schemeOpenModuleImage_pullback_unique
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U V : X.Opens) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    {Z : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)}
    {l l' : Z ⟶ M}
    (hu : l ≫ (schemeOpenModuleAdjunction X U).unit.app M =
      l' ≫ (schemeOpenModuleAdjunction X U).unit.app M)
    (hv : l ≫ (schemeOpenModuleAdjunction X V).unit.app M =
      l' ≫ (schemeOpenModuleAdjunction X V).unit.app M) :
    l = l'

title: Uniqueness of an amalgamation for open restrictions
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $U,V$ be open subsets with $U\cup V=X$, and let $M,Z$ be sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For an open $A$, let $M_A=j_{A*}r_A M$ and $\eta_A:M\to M_A$ be the transported restriction/direct-image unit of [def-pc-kinjective-mayer-vietoris-data]. If $l,l\prime:Z\to M$ satisfy $\eta_U\circ l=\eta_U\circ l\prime$ and $\eta_V\circ l=\eta_V\circ l\prime$, then $l=l\prime$.

proof.text: Expand Adjunction.ofNatIsoLeft_unit and cancel the pushforward of overFunctorEquiv.inv, which is an isomorphism. This turns each hypothesis into equality after the ordinary restriction unit.

Evaluate both morphism equalities on a test open T and a section z of Z(T). restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app identifies them with equality of restrictions to the image-preimage opens for U and V. image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf identifies these opens with U intersection T and V intersection T, whose join is T. Apply TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq₂ (Mathlib/Topology/Sheaves/SheafCondition/UniqueGluing.lean:237), then Scheme.Modules.hom_ext and group-homomorphism extensionality.
